delta_convention: candidate minus reference; negative is better in that component; outcomes use the whole lexicographic tuple

method.diagnostic_status: Post-hoc mechanism diagnosis, specified while the screen batch was running; it does not change the frozen experiment gates or constitute a new confirmatory test.
method.phase_boundary: Use payload metadata timestamps (no construction offset), retain iteration <= warmup iterations and time strictly below warmup runtime; excludes relay seeding at adjusted warmup iteration.
method.terminal_removal: If accepted, remove exactly the last DIRECT improvement after matching its score and preceding incumbent to terminal metadata.
method.common_iteration_limit: max(0, min(reference completed_iterations, candidate completed_iterations) - 1); excludes a possibly timed-out final iteration in either run, while retaining the initialization point.
method.prefix_comparison: Exact ordered (iteration, late count, total lateness, distance) entries up to the common limit; ignore all timestamps.
method.scope: Recorded best-incumbent prefixes, not every accepted state, route, random draw or operator decision.
method.validation_selection: Validate has only the prespecified selected variant; absent terminal relay pairs are not inferred or substituted with rebalanced pairs.

evidence_summary: Terminal has 18 recorded baseline pairs; 18 have identical observed DIRECT incumbent prefixes through the conservative common iteration.
Of 7 net terminal losses, 7 share that common prefix, 7 end at fewer DIRECT iterations, and 6 still received a strict terminal improvement.
Equal prefixes with different endpoint scores are consistent with different wall-clock cutoff positions on the recorded incumbent sequence. They do not establish the cause of the runtime difference.
Terminal's before/after gain is a local observed change, while the paired final score includes main-search cutoff effects and, for staged cases, the subsequent relay search.
limitations: Do not attribute iteration-count or score differences separately to host noise, the reserved slice, or implementation speed: this batch did not isolate those causes.
An equal incumbent prefix is not proof that all internal search states, RNG draws or operator decisions were identical.

Rebalanced deliberately changes phase duration and enables the existing relay seed checkpoint. Its separate prefix observations are not pooled with the terminal-only comparison or treated as a pure ratio ablation.
Componentwise deltas describe scores; they are not additive causal attributions, especially after the relay phase starts from a changed warmup incumbent.
